entries.zh: 激怒；发怒，动怒
entries.en: to get angry; to become irritated

entries.zh: 激忿；因小事动怒
entries.en: to take offense at trifles; to get angry over little things
entries.notes: H「忿」字带[疑:忿/念]标记，两字对音均合 hun，不碍语义。

entries.zh: 激气；怄气，恼怒
entries.en: to get vexed; to take offense

entries.zh: 含怒、愠怒；荆棘（喻脾气多刺、易触怒人）
entries.en: to be angry, in a state of anger; prickly (like thorns)
entries.notes: H「荆棘」取「多刺易怒」之喻，四栏同指动怒，故从含怒义。

entries.zh: 怒气冲天；盛怒，大发雷霆
entries.en: to fly into a towering rage; enraged to the skies
entries.notes: M 栏词形夹入西语词 mucho，系原稿混入，不影响四栏互证。

entries.zh: 切身切命；因绝望而暴怒（拼命之怒）
entries.en: to rage out of desperation; desperate fury

entries.zh: 怒切于心；怨愤深入内心
entries.en: to rage with resentment that cuts to the heart
entries.notes: L 词头讹误（imperior muy de rico 不成句，疑为 muy de recio），释义依 H/M/R「切入心」及 enojarse 主义推断。

entries.zh: 切啼；怒极而啼哭，悲愤而泣
entries.en: to weep with rage; to cry in anger

entries.zh: 触怒；触犯长上而惹其动怒
entries.en: to provoke anger (of a superior at disobedience)

entries.zh: 气僻；乖戾使气，坏脾气地动怒
entries.en: to fly into an ill-tempered, perverse rage
entries.notes: R 第二音节调号污损（T99），释义依 L/H/M（并见 pia/pēg 两词形）定为气僻乖戾之怒。

entries.zh: 发威；突然发作，勃然大怒
entries.en: to burst out in sudden wrath; to fly into a rage
entries.notes: M 栏另附词形 auquūite 未能确解，释义依 huatvey（发威）与 L/R。

entries.zh: 火发；怒火爆发，火冒三丈
entries.en: to blaze up with anger like a fire

entries.zh: 愾尽死；气得要死，怒而欲杀人
entries.en: to be angry to death; furious to the point of wanting to kill
entries.notes: H「愾」带[疑:愾/氣]标记，两读同音，语义不变。

entries.zh: 妒恨；因妒生怨而动怒
entries.en: jealous, spiteful anger; to rage out of envy
entries.notes: H「姬」带[疑:姬/妒]标记且 L 词形连写讹误（lleganalosmenos y depegar），据「妒恨」与 enojarse 义推断。

entries.zh: 闷煎愁苦；怒而生悲
entries.en: to anguish in grief; anger that brings sorrow
entries.notes: M 首音节调号污损（T99），且 H「吞占」与 R「būn chiēn」（闷煎）对音不合，语义据 L「enojarse & da pena」与 R 定为愁闷煎熬。

entries.zh: 威严；动怒显威，怒而凛然
entries.en: to anger with imposing majesty; wrathful authority

entries.zh: 愠怒；怒形于色，面色难看
entries.en: sullen anger; angry with an ill countenance
entries.notes: 「溫怒」读为「愠怒」（含怒于色），与 mal semblante（怒容）相合。

entries.zh: 使性；使性子，动辄发怒使气
entries.en: irascible, prone to tantrums; of a bad temper

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to bind (books)
entries.notes: R 栏空缺，H「柄」/M「ge」与 enquadernar 装订义不合，zh 从缺；西语词头明确，en 依 L 给出。

entries.zh: 装订；装钉书籍
entries.en: to bind books; bookbinding
entries.notes: H「裝」带[疑:裝/栓]标记，M「chūng teng」与装钉相合，从装订义。

entries.zh: 钉书；钉缀成册（装订书籍）
entries.en: to bind or stitch books
entries.notes: H「釘」带[疑:釘/鐙]标记，M/R 均读 teng-chū，从钉书义。
